records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased by $10.6 million, or 9%, during the three months ended March 31, 2021, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2020, primarily due to an increase in organic volume of $11.2 million, as a result of increased demand in the automotive industry as the economy begins to recover from the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: While managing decreased demand in many regions across the globe, we are now operating at all of our business locations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have been increasing our inventories in the first quarter to mitigate the risk of supply chain disruption for our customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales were positively impacted by increased selling prices for precious metals allowed under customer contracts due to the sharp rise in underlying commodities costs since the second half of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations increased by $5.8 million during the three months ended March 31, 2021, compared to the same period in the prior year primarily due to the above-noted increase in revenue and variable and fixed cost reduction initiatives.
